desc: Capture by scan (docs/decisions/0002). A wild Boki that is knocked out (dazed) can be scanned: hold the interact key for hold_s to commit, then the scan runs by itself for scan_s. Times in seconds, distances in metres.
box_capacity_doc: How many wisps (scanned Boki) a hunter can hold in the run box (Hunter.caught; docs/decisions/0022). Full: keep holding interact for swap_hold_s to swap the oldest one out (it is let go), or walk away to leave it.
